name: Auto Apply Coupons – Automatic Discounts at Checkout for WooCommerce
author: storeapps

sections.description:
Automatically apply coupon codes at cart or checkout in WooCommerce, eliminating the need for customers to search and enter coupon codes.

No typing. No missed discounts. No checkout friction.

When eligible conditions are met, the coupon is applied automatically. This creates a smoother shopping experience for users and improves conversions.

Top 6 auto apply coupon use cases for better conversions

  • Store-wide discount — run automatic discounts for all visitors across your store.
  • New launches and stock clearance — apply coupons only when selected products or categories are added to the cart.
  • Flash sales — trigger instant discount during time-sensitive campaigns.
  • Cart-value based offers — apply coupon promo code above a minimum cart total. (Example – Get 10% off on orders above $150).
  • Festive and holiday season offers — apply discounts on Black Friday, Christmas, New Year, Valentine’s Day, or any special occasion for quick checkout.
  • Customer loyalty — apply exclusive discounts for existing customers without requiring them to enter coupon codes.

Key features

  • Go live quickly — create a coupon, enable auto-apply, and publish.
  • Works with all coupon types — supports store credits and all default WooCommerce discount types.
  • Unlimited coupons — create multiple auto-apply coupons (only one active at a time).
  • Subscription coupons — auto-apply coupons for sign-up fee and recurring product discount coupons (compatibility with WooCommerce Subscriptions).
  • Cart-based conditions — apply coupons based on minimum or maximum cart total.
  • Product-based conditions — trigger discounts only for specific products or categories.
  • WooCommerce Blocks compatible.

Note: Coupons are auto-applied only when there is at least one product in the cart.

Benefits of auto-apply coupons

  • Reduces coupon errors by eliminating incorrect or forgotten coupon code entries.
  • Encourages higher conversions by applying instant discounts at checkout.
  • Improves mobile shopping experience with faster, smoother checkout and no manual entry.
  • Increases loyalty when specific customers get exclusive coupon codes via email.
  • Reduces support queries related to coupon issues and failed redemptions.

Need more advanced auto-apply coupon features?

Try the official Smart Coupons plugin by StoreApps, for more flexibility and advanced options.

  • Allow multiple auto-apply coupons (five by default, more with customization).
  • Bulk generate unique coupon codes and set them to auto-apply.
  • Restrict auto-applied coupons based on payment method, location, quantity, etc.
  • Offer a free product automatically (BOGO) when customers buy a qualifying item.

Why StoreApps?

  • Official WooCommerce extensions developer
  • Consistent 5-star reviews, 14+ years in the business
  • Highly-rated human support
  • Quality code, 330K+ happy customers
sections.installation:
1. Unzip and upload contents of the plugin to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Auto Apply Coupons. Search & select a coupon under Select a Coupon for Auto Apply for which you want to enable auto apply.
  4. Save the settings.
sections.faq:
How to auto apply a coupon in WooCommerce?

  • Install and activate this plugin.
  • Create a coupon, set restrictions, limits, and publish it.
  • Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Auto apply coupons.
  • Search and enter the coupon code created above and save the settings.

How do I add a 20% discount in WooCommerce?

  • Create a coupon.
  • Set the discount type to ‘Percentage discount’.
  • Enter 20 as the discount amount.
  • Set restrictions and publish.

How do I create bulk coupons in WooCommerce?
